audit.whatIsWrong: This is the worst chart in the slice. content win[] gives Vayne all seven stages and full.phases gives her all seven at 3/10, while the entry's own early says 'levels 1-2 already favour Aatrox', mid says 'Levels 3 through first item are Aatrox-favoured', and all seven whys describe Aatrox winning until two items. The packet chart reads Aatrox for six stages and Vayne only at Two+ items.
audit.why: Vayne is a short-range, squishy marksman whose only peel is a 20s Condemn at rank 1. Aatrox is at 52.7% over 2852 games. A chart telling the player they lose Level 1 to a Vayne is directly opposite to the advice printed beside it.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through First item read Aatrox in both layers; Two+ items stays Vayne.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn, Tumble and Final Hour are all discussed without cooldowns, so 'save an E dash to dodge her Condemn' has no timer behind it.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12 — at rank 1 that is a twenty-second window in which she has no peel at all, the longest punish window Aatrox gets in any ranged matchup. Tumble is 6s down to 2s and Final Hour 100/85/70.
audit.corrected: 20s Condemn stated in spikes[0] and mid; 100s Final Hour in spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics are stated loosely enough to mislead. Condemn is described only as a stun — it knocks you back regardless, and only stuns if you collide with terrain, which means where you stand decides whether it is an interrupt or a free reposition for her. And Silver Bolts is described as an auto-attack stack, but its third hit counts abilities as well as attacks, so her true-damage proc arrives faster than the entry implies.
audit.why: Riot's text: Condemn — 'fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them'; Silver Bolts — 'The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.' Fighting in the open lane instead of against the side wall downgrades her best defensive tool to a knockback you simply walk out of.
audit.corrected: Terrain condition on the Condemn stun and the 'attack or ability' wording of Silver Bolts stated in spikes[0], spikes[2] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Final Hour is called 'R invisibility' as if she vanishes at will.
audit.why: Riot's text grants 'Invisibility during Tumble' — the stealth exists only for the duration of the Tumble itself, alongside bonus AD, a reduced Tumble cooldown and more Night Hunter move speed. That is a repositioning tool inside her dash, not a disappearing act, and it matters because it means she is visible again the instant the tumble ends.
audit.corrected: Stated in late as invisibility during Tumble only.

edits.before: Once your Q pattern and E are up, force the all-in: use E to close her Tumble (Q) spacing and land the third-Q knockup before she can Condemn (E) you into the wall.
edits.after: Force the all-in once your Q pattern is up, and fight in open lane: Condemn (20s) only stuns if it slams you into terrain, and off a wall it is a knockback you walk back through.

edits.before: World Ender's stats and heal amp let you run her down through Silver Bolts procs; save an E dash to dodge her Condemn stun so she can't peel your engage.
edits.after: World Ender's stats and heal amp run her down through Silver Bolts; Final Hour (100s) hides her only for the length of a Tumble, so she is visible the instant it ends.

edits.before: After your first bruiser item you out-brawl her hard in melee — chain Q sweetspots and W pull so she can't kite, and her true-damage bolts won't out-sustain your drain.
edits.after: After your first bruiser item you out-brawl her in melee — chain Q sweetspots and drag her back so she cannot kite. Silver Bolts counts abilities too, so her true damage lands fast.

edits.before: Levels 3 through first item are Aatrox-favoured — this is where a melee drain fighter should win against a scaling marksman. Use E to erase her Tumble spacing, land your third-Q knockup, and W-pull her so she can't Condemn to safety. Her Silver Bolts hurt but your drain plus R heal amp out-sustains her this early. Kill her repeatedly now, because every item she gets narrows your window.
edits.after: Levels 3 through first item are Aatrox-favoured — a melee drain fighter should beat a scaling marksman here. Erase her Tumble spacing, land the third-Q knockup, and chain her before Condemn (20s at rank 1) comes back. Pick the fight away from the side wall: with no terrain behind you the bolt only knocks you back, it never stuns. Kill her repeatedly, because every item narrows your window.

edits.before: Dodge or bait Condemn (E) so she can't wall-stun your engage
edits.after: Fight away from the wall so Condemn only pushes you back

edits.before: Vayne changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Vayne Tumble, Condemn, and R. Aatrox wins by controlling spacing with his first two Q swings, holding E until the enemy punish tool is committed, and managing the wave so the enemy must walk into the outer edge of his Q. Vayne wants to keep distance, poke Aatrox before he can reach the wave, and punish missed Qs with ranged damage or crowd control.
edits.after: Vayne changes the lane by forcing Aatrox to respect Condemn (E, 20s), which only stuns if it slams him into terrain, and Silver Bolts, whose third attack or ability burns a share of max health as true damage. Aatrox wins by fighting away from the side wall, spacing with his first two Darkin Blade swings, and killing her again and again before her second item lands.

notes: packet suspectNames flags "World Ender's" and 'Her Silver Bolts' as probable wrong names. Both are FALSE POSITIVES — the matcher is tripping on a possessive and on a leading pronoun; both names are correct per Riot Data Dragon. No edits made on that basis.
